name: Xiaomi YU7
summary: The Xiaomi YU7 (Chinese: 小米YU7; pinyin: Xiǎomǐ YU7) is a battery electric mid-size SUV developed by Xiaomi Auto, the electric vehicle subsidiary of the Chinese consumer electronics company Xiaomi. It is Xiaomi's second vehicle following the SU7, and is the brand's first SUV. According to Xiaomi's announcement of 28 March 2025, the Chinese pronunciation of YU7 is "小米御7" (pinyin:xiǎomǐ yùqī), where "御" (pinyin:"yù") means "land chariot, riding the wind". The YU7 is available in three variants: YU7, YU7 Pro, and YU7 Max. The YU7 is expected to become the biggest threat to the Tesla Model Y's dominance of the premium electric crossover segment in China, of which it was the sales leader in the segment since its introduction to the Chinese market in 2021.
